findings.namedBuyers: Sam Petryna, OWWA Conference & Sales Manager, is the strongest first operational contact; official public email spetryna@owwa.ca, telephone 416-231-1555 ext. 102. Michele Grenier, OWWA Executive Director, is a senior organizer relationship/escalation contact; mgrenier@owwa.ca, 416-231-1555 ext. 103. Mary Beth Holmes, WEAO Executive Director, is a named co-owner-side relationship contact; no individual email or telephone verified here. These roles establish commercial relevance, not authority to execute hotel contracts. Accommodation procurement/signatory responsibility remains unknown.
findings.futureEdition: Confirmed upcoming within the requested horizon: May 10–13, 2027. OWWA gives activity times of May 10 at 1:00 pm through May 13 at 4:00 pm; these are event dates, not publication dates. WEAO’s announcement was published August 12, 2026 and marked updated October 14, 2026. The edition is jointly hosted by OWWA and WEAO. No later Toronto joint edition with exact dates was verified.
findings.hotelProductFit: Inference using the supplied hotel specifications: a 157-room Harbourfront city hotel is unsuitable as exclusive housing or plenary venue for the published expectation of more than 2,000 professionals. A targeted delegate, speaker, VIP or exhibitor-team sub-block could fit; approximately 15–109 peak rooms is a sales targeting envelope supplied in the brief, NOT published demand from this event. Exhibition Place gives a relevant Toronto geography, but MTCC walkability is not proof of walkability to this event. Treat venue transfers as a practical sales issue. Side meetings may fit the supplied ballroom capacities; any catered reception must await verification of restaurant/lounge and banquet service capability. This edition is city-convention demand, not a resort retreat.
findings.venueCommitments: Officially announced venue: Enercare Centre, Exhibition Place, 100 Princes’ Blvd, Toronto, Ontario, Canada. WEAO names the Exhibition Place campus; OWWA’s conference calendar specifies Enercare and its address. This is Toronto proper, in the supplied Exhibition Place demand territory, not Niagara Falls or an airport/suburban venue. The public announcement establishes venue selection, not access to a signed venue contract. Individual halls, meeting-room allocations and any additional campus buildings remain unverified.
findings.historicalRotation: Verified joint-edition comparison: May 5–7, 2024, Niagara Falls Convention Centre, Niagara Falls; May 10–13, 2027, Enercare/Exhibition Place, Toronto. Do not infer an annual Toronto event or a fixed three-year joint cycle from these two editions. The associations ran separate conferences in 2025 and 2026: WEAO in London in April 2025 and Niagara Falls in April 2026; OWWA in The Blue Mountains in May 2025 and Niagara Falls in May 2026. OWWA’s 2026 AGM package reproduces 2025 minutes stating a return to Niagara Falls in 2028; this is an OWWA city/year plan, not confirmation of a 2028 joint Toronto edition. Exact 2028 dates and venue were not verified.
findings.accommodationSourcing: Edition-specific room blocks are already announced at EVERY hotel listed by WEAO: Hotel X; Sheraton Centre Toronto; Hyatt Regency Toronto; Le Méridien Toronto Pinnacle Hotel. Exact quotation: “Conference hotel reservations will open October 20, with room blocks available at Hotel X, Sheraton Centre Toronto, Hyatt Regency Toronto and Le Méridien Toronto Pinnacle Hotel.” Additional quotation: “Exhibitors will receive priority booking access to Hotel X once their booth purchase has been confirmed.” The surrounding announcement identifies the opening cycle as October 2026. This establishes organized room-block sourcing and incumbents, not a merely generic preferred-hotel list. No named housing bureau, open hotel RFP, block sizes, booking codes, rates, cutoff dates or current availability were verified. The published inquiry route is conference@owwa.ca. The exhibitor portal is a booth-sales route; it is not evidence of a housing bureau or hotel booking channel.
findings.organizationStructure: Association-owned joint programme: Ontario Water Works Association and Water Environment Association of Ontario are the named hosts, not the convention venue or hotels. OWWA describes itself as a voluntary not-for-profit organization and a section of AWWA; WEAO describes itself as a not-for-profit technical and educational organization. Enercare/Exhibition Place is the event venue. The four named hotels are accommodation incumbents. No external PCO, DMC, agency or housing contractor was identified in the reviewed edition-specific evidence.
findings.competitiveLimitations: The four official hotel blocks constrain a new primary accommodation bid. Hotel X also has explicitly stated exhibitor priority access, an incumbent advantage. No sold-out block, contracted overflow requirement, displacement, pickup shortfall or unmet lodging request was found. The expected attendance of more than 2,000 and more than 200 exhibitors is not an overnight-demand count and cannot support a room-night or peak-room estimate. Public room-block announcements do not prove that all accommodation is exclusive or that all inventory is closed.
findings.recommendedSalesAction: Contact Sam Petryna first, using spetryna@owwa.ca or the edition-specific conference@owwa.ca, with a concise supplemental-lodging proposal for May 10–13, 2027. Ask who manages hotel blocks, whether an additional hotel/sub-block is permissible, and whether any speaker, exhibitor or VIP subgroup has an unmet requirement. Offer only hotel-confirmed dates, rates, inventory and services; do not describe this as an open RFP or guaranteed overflow. Seek an introduction to the actual accommodation decision-maker, then involve Michele Grenier and/or Mary Beth Holmes for longer-term Toronto planning if appropriate. Ask the next Toronto host-selection and accommodation-selection timing before committing bid effort.
findings.currentEditionAccessibility: As of November 15, 2026, the 2027 venue and accommodation incumbents are publicly established. Qualify as a constrained supplemental-lodging relationship prospect, not verified open sourcing. The advertised October 20 reservation opening has passed, but live booking availability and the actual booking channel were not verified. Radisson Blu is not named in the published blocks. No basis was found to assert either that new hotels are being sought or that all opportunities are closed.
findings.futureCompetitiveCapturePotential: Inference: develop a relationship now for any organizer-approved additional 2027 sub-block and for a future Toronto return before accommodation selection. Do not treat 2028 as a Toronto capture cycle: OWWA’s published planning record points to Niagara Falls that year, with no exact dates verified. Joint-edition recurrence is evidenced by 2024 and 2027, but its cadence, next Toronto year and future accommodation tender timetable are unconfirmed.
